user.title: Charge Tally ledger
user.description:
- All charging points and records share one currency.
- Change it in Configure → Ledger settings when no charging points (including archived points) or accounting data remain. Identities alone do not lock it.
- Removing a point keeps its history and the currency lock; fully clearing points and related data through Manage archived data allows changes again.
- Dynamic prices must use the same currency; amounts are never converted automatically.
- Removing the entire integration permanently deletes its ledger and private data. Adding it again creates a fresh ledger in the selected currency.
- Old ledger files left by a previously removed integration are cleared when you submit this form.

locked.title: Ledger currency locked
locked.description:
- Current currency: **{currency}**.
- Charging points or retained accounting data lock the currency, even before the first charge. Removing a point alone does not unlock it.
- Currency changes become available after all points and related data are cleared through Manage archived data.
- Historical amounts are not converted or recalculated. Dynamic prices must use this currency.
- Configure charging points and identities through their own entries.

currency.title: Ledger settings
currency.description:
- Current currency: **{currency}**.
- No charging points or accounting data remain, so you can change the currency. Identities are preserved.
- Adding a point locks it; fully clearing all points and related data allows changes again.
- Dynamic prices must match; no currency conversion is performed.
